description: Test suite for the CLI session helper functions, validating behavior for session binding, reuse, invalidation, clearing, and hashing.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite with a description.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Creates an assertion for test validation.

methods.name: setCliSessionBinding
methods.description: Sets or updates CLI session binding metadata for an entry.

methods.name: getCliSessionBinding
methods.description: Retrieves the CLI session binding metadata for an entry.

methods.name: resolveCliSessionReuse
methods.description: Determines if a session binding is reusable or invalidated based on provided criteria.

methods.name: clearCliSession
methods.description: Clears specific CLI session bindings from the entry.

methods.name: clearAllCliSessions
methods.description: Clears all CLI session-related state from the entry.

methods.name: hashCliSessionText
methods.description: Creates a hash of a trimmed CLI session prompt text; returns undefined if input is empty.
